scope: PostgreSQL custom-enum parameter inference in UNION ALL and VALUES
contract: An enum parameter in either UNION ALL branch and either VALUES row is inferred as the schema-qualified enum type.
Ordinary, empty, literal NULL, and SQL NULL values match typed native enum literal results and enum_send bytes.
Invalid enum labels in all four parameter positions preserve PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 22P02.

After warming a transaction under the target schema, reusing the prepared UNION ALL and VALUES statements under a same-named shadow-first search_path still infers the target table enum and rejects shadow-only labels.

enum_tests.command: rtk cargo test --offline --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration value_contract_enum_ -- --ignored --test-threads=1

remaining: Additional PostgreSQL enum parameter contexts, schema/search_path configurations, deeper type boundaries, and the broader eight-driver B3 matrix remain open.
This focused native test does not qualify B3 or the 0.2.0 release.
